title: Why I Sing Even Though I Was Told I Never Should
subtitle: I Spent My Life Hating My Voice. This Is What Changed.
author: Rafi Barides
description: After years of being told I'd never be a singer, I share my journey from hating my voice to releasing an album. Learn how I transformed my vocals through persistence, breathing techniques, and embracing my unique sound.

title: The Other Half of My Music
subtitle: How Photography Became the Visual Language for My Sound
author: Rafi Barides
description: From borrowing a Nikon D3200 in yeshivah to becoming a Getty Images contributor, photography evolved into the visual companion to my music. Discover how self-portraits and image-making help me translate sound into emotion.
